verdict.rationale: Quo documents one-click Claude and ChatGPT connectors and a public MCP server. Through these, users can manage conversations, contacts, and call transcripts "in plain English," covering summaries, sending texts and broadcasts, filtering message history, call and voicemail transcripts, contact edits, and missed calls. The documented scope covers communications data only, not the broader product (call routing, phone menus, Sona configuration, number setup), and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: natural-language control of routing, phone menus, Sona and workspace settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
One-click connectors for Claude and ChatGPT, plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on.
Send a text to one person or broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
Pull messages and call activity from any Quo inbox and ask for a summary.
